name: University of Washington Institute for Protein Design

profile.summary: The IPD, part of the UW School of Medicine, is the hub of computational and AI-driven de novo protein design (Rosetta, RFdiffusion), and it produced the first computationally designed protein medicine to be approved (the SKYCovione COVID-19 vaccine). Its Translational Investigator Program has seeded 11 spinouts whose alumni have raised more than $1B, and Baker-lab tools also underpin outside companies such as Xaira and Arzeda.

labs.known_for: Rosetta, RFdiffusion; de novo protein design; 2024 Nobel Prize
Self-assembling protein nanoparticles; designed nanoparticle vaccines
Co-founded Archon, Lila, Mopac, Vilya, Transcyton
